business_summary: Beijing Trust & Far Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides data center information technology infrastructure operation and maintenance services in China. The company offers intelligent integrated operation and maintenance management system based on big data, which is for monitoring level and fault response; DBScale database container platform, which is for building an enterprise-grade database container cloud management platform; cloud operation and maintenance platform for small and medium enterprises that standardizes, automates, and modularizes tasks previously performed by operations engineers; enterprise-level converged distributed data processing platform, which is for connecting big data, data integration, and internet connectivity; BrowseView SRM system monitoring software, a web-based system monitoring solution that enables centralized monitoring of data center IT infrastructure; and BrowseView OMM, an IT operations and maintenance management product that takes the system and process management of IT service management. It also provides IT infrastructure maintenance services; system integration; human outsourcing; on-site project management; database container; integrated operation and maintenance; open-source business services; information technology business products and services; and monitoring and operations open-source software solutions. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
